title: Camper Van Village with Food Truck
sourceTitle: POKOPIA CAMPER VANS! Functional House Build + Food Truck & Outdoor Shop!
creator: zoibean
summary: A cheerful Pokopia camper village with custom camper vans, striped awnings, outdoor seating, flowers, and cozy shop details.
publicNotes:
## Build Notes

This camper village turns two compact house builds into a cheerful little stopover: one larger camper with a striped awning and rooftop details, plus a smaller food-truck-style build with outdoor seating, flowers, lights, and display shelves.

The creator's recommended items slide calls out early-game-friendly pieces for the camper shape and roof details, including painted walls, curved eaves, glass windows, stone roof pieces, and sideways logs.
aiReviewPrompt:
Review the captured frames in curation/youtube-mcq2-nwkdcg/frames for a Pokemon Pokopia build.

Use data/pokopia-item-catalog.json as the item vocabulary when present, falling back to data/items.json. Suggest likely exact item names, tags, and a short public summary.
Keep confidence and rejected guesses in this private curation JSON only. Do not publish confidence scores to the website.
Pick selectedFrame only after visually confirming it shows the complete build, not the intro, creator face, UI chrome, or a transition.
The script auto-picked selectedFrame from frameAnalyses; treat that as a ranked suggestion, not a final visual review.
Prefer frames that show a finished whole build, usually showcase or recap moments near the beginning or end of a video.
For compilation videos, use sourceTimeSeconds to identify separate builds and pick the strongest full-building frame for each useful entry.
